primary_defense_in_depth_candidate.name: RestrictedPython
primary_defense_in_depth_candidate.reason: Upstream explicitly states that RestrictedPython is not a sandbox or secured environment.

windows_isolation_candidates.name: Microsoft eXecution Container (MXC)
windows_isolation_candidates.reason: Upstream calls the repository an early preview, identifies overly permissive generated policies, and says profiles are not security boundaries.

windows_isolation_candidates.name: Sandboxie Plus
windows_isolation_candidates.reason: Windows isolation features are relevant, but Phase 8 has no package-bound, independently attested provider integration.

windows_isolation_candidates.name: gVisor
windows_isolation_candidates.reason: The supported runtime requires Linux 5.6+ and does not provide a Windows-native backend.
